CHANGES (tree <home>/dev/audit-plugin/claude-plugins-P152.6, base 92c399f5, nothing committed). (1) _id_shape.current_branch: git's answer is kept per realpath(cwd) beside a witness made of the HEAD file's path and bytes. On every call the file is found by git's own discovery walk: a .git dir shaped like a git dir, the dir that a .git file's `gitdir:` line names (that pointer is read on every call), or a bare git dir. A walk that finds no repository is itself a witness, so the None outside a repository is kept until a repository appears above. An answer is kept only when it is the name the HEAD bytes spell, or None beside a detached HEAD or no HEAD. A GIT_DIR-family variable (read by reference from _config._DISCOVERY_ENV through _loader) keeps nothing. The first ask in a process still costs exactly one git process. (2) usage_ledger.resolve_author(repo_root, mode, cache=True): user.email and user.name now come from ONE `git config -z --show-origin --get-regexp '^(user\.(email|name)|include\.path|includeif\..+\.path)$'`; before, the two keys were two processes. The answer is kept per process. WITNESS: identity_env() (every GIT_ variable plus HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, USER and USERNAME, by value) and file_witness() (BYTES; absent files recorded as absent) over identity_files(). identity_files covers the global, XDG and system configs where the environment puts them; for every ancestor, the .git entry and the config, config.worktree and HEAD beside it; behind a gitdir: pointer, the worktree's config.worktree, HEAD and commondir and the shared config; and every origin and include target named in git's answer. Files known before git is asked are read before AND after the question, and an answer whose files moved under it is returned but not kept. Stated limit: a system config at a build-specific path that holds no identity or include key is not watched. (3) _panel_viewer: the viewer cache token changed from stat plus a 1-second settle window to bytes through usage_ledger.file_witness, with the same before/after race check. A config written a moment ago is now kept, so _git_config_origins runs only when the token moved. _identity_env and _git_config_candidates now delegate to usage_ledger (one home). _resolve_viewer calls resolve_author(cache=False); this is labelled defensive because no case can place the one file it covers. The unused _panel_discovery import was dropped and all seven names _panel_state re-exports were kept. (4) _journal_io._worktree_key_uncached: rev-parse --git-dir --git-common-dir now goes through _config.git_place, whose witness is the identity of the top's .git entry. A project below a linked worktree's top therefore asks once per process instead of once per append; the token file is still read on every call that reaches it. (5) PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md: one sentence per touched module stating its witness, and the module map regenerated with `python3 tools/lints/_deps.py --write-map` (_id_shape gains _loader, _panel_viewer loses _panel_discovery). _deps.py: no GIT_PATH_BASE_EXEMPT row or other function-keyed row names any of the four functions (grep of tools/ for resolve_author|current_branch|_git_config_origins|_worktree_key_uncached found none), so no row moved; test__deps 254/254.
